qe: Which enzyme is found in human saliva that initiates the digestion of starch?
qh: मानव लार में कौन सा एंजाइम पाया जाता है जो स्टार्च का पाचन शुरू करता है?
e: Concept: Paachan (digestion) muh se hi shuru ho jata hai - laar (saliva) me ek enzyme hota hai jo starch (kand-mool, chawal, aata) ko sugar me todna shuru karta hai. Is enzyme ka naam Ptyalin (Salivary Amylase) hai, aur yahi wajah hai ki roti/chaawal ko chabakar der tak muh me rakhne par mitha swad aata hai. Baaki teen enzymes yahan kaam nahi karte: Lipase fat todta hai (ye pancreas me hota hai), Trypsin protein todta hai (pancreas ka enzyme), aur Pepsin protein todta hai (pet me). Exam point: 'Muh me starch ki digestion = Ptyalin/Salivary amylase'.

qe: What is the typical pH value of gastric juice (HCl) in the human stomach?
qh: आमाशय में जठर रस (HCl) का सामान्य pH मान कितना होता है?
e: Concept: Pet me HCl (hydrochloric acid) banta hai jo khaana paachne ke saath-saath khaane ke keetnu (bacteria) ko bhi maarta hai. Iski normal acidity bahut tez hoti hai - pH 1.5 se 3.5 tak - yahi khaana todne wale enzymes ko kaam karne ka mahaul deti hai. Baaki teen values pH scale ke doosre bhaagon ki hain: 5.6 halka tezab, 7.0 neutral (paani), aur 8.5 khare (alkaline, jaise aanto ka). Exam point: 'Gastric juice ka pH = 1.5-3.5 (bahut tezab); ise mukot bang karne wali layered mucus chhodhti hai'.

qe: Which enzyme converts dietary proteins into peptones in the acidic medium of the stomach?
qh: आमाशय के अम्लीय माध्यम में कौन सा एंजाइम प्रोटीन को पेप्टोन में बदलता है?
e: Concept: Pet me protein paachne ke liye ek khaas enzyme hota hai jo tezabi (acidic) mahaul me hi kaam karta hai - Pepsin. Ye protein ko chhoti chains (peptones) me todta hai, aur iska 'inactive' roop pepsinogen (chief cells me banta hai) hai, jo HCl ke sampark me active pepsin ban jata hai. Baaki teen enzymes yahan kaam nahi karte: Lipase fat todta hai (ye pancreatic juice me hai), Amylase starch todta hai, aur Trypsin protein todta hai par alkaline mahaul me (pancreas se aata hai). Exam point: 'Pet ka protein-digesting enzyme = Pepsin (HCl ke saath kaam karta hai)'.

qe: What is the primary function of dietary 'Roughage' (fiber) in the digestive system?
qh: पाचन में 'रुक्षांश' (फाइबर/मोटा चारा) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Aiding bowel movement and preventing constipation
e: Concept: Roughage (dietary fibre) wo hissa hai jo hamara sharir paach nahi sakta (jaise sabzi-fal ke chhilke, chokar) - ye khud energy nahi deta, par aanton ko chalne me madad karta hai: ye paani soakkar stool ko naram aur bhaari banata hai, jisse kabz (constipation) nahi hoti aur aanton ka movement sahi rehta hai. Iske ilawa ye heart health aur sugar control me faaydemand hai. Baaki teen kaam roughage nahi karta: turant energy, fat-soluble vitamins banana (vitamins sirf khane se aate hain) aur muscle mass banana. Exam point: 'Roughage = fibre = constipation door karta hai (khaane ke reshe/dhage)'.

qe: Where is Bile produced and where is it stored and concentrated in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर में पित्त (Bile) क्रमशः कहाँ बनता है और कहाँ संचित होता है?
o: Produced in Spleen, Stored in Kidney
Produced in Liver, Stored in Gallbladder
Produced in Gallbladder, Stored in Liver
Produced in Stomach, Stored in Pancreas
e: Concept: Bile (pita ras) liver me banti hai aur wahan se gallbladder (pittashay) ki thaili me jaakar jama hoti hai aur concentrate hoti hai; khaana aane par gallbladder sikud kar bile ko duodenum me chhodti hai. Bile ke salts fat ko chhote boond me todte hain (emulsification) aur liver ke waste (bilirubin) ko bahar nikaalte hain. Baaki teen options ulte ya galat hain: Spleen bile nahi banata, gallbladder production site nahi (sirf store), aur stomach-pancreas ka bile se rishta nahi. Exam point: 'Bile = Liver me banti hai, Gallbladder me store hoti hai (pathri bhi wahi banti hai)'.

qe: Which organ in the human body possesses the highest capacity for cellular division and regeneration?
qh: मानव शरीर के किस अंग में कोशिका विभाजन और पुनर्योजन (Regeneration) की क्षमता सबसे अधिक होती है?
e: Concept: Liver (yakrit) body ka 'chemical factory' hai - isme lagbhag 500 kaam hote hain (bile banana, detox, protein, sugar management). Sabse badi baat ye hai ki liver ki cells (hepatocytes) division karne ki shakti rakhte hain, isliye agar liver ka ek hissa nikal diya jaye to wo dobara ug jata hai (regeneration) - isi wajah se living donor liver transplant mumkin hai. Baaki teen organs kamzoor hain: Heart ke muscle cells lagbhag divide nahi karte, Kidney limited, aur Brain ke neurons to mature hone ke baad divide nahi karte. Exam point: 'Sabse zyada regeneration = Liver (yahi wajah hai ki liver cancer ke baad bhi bacha jata hai)'.

qe: Which intestinal hormone stimulates the Gallbladder to contract and discharge concentrated bile?
qh: कौन सा हार्मोन पित्ताशय को सिकोड़कर पित्त (Bile) छोड़ने के लिए उत्तेजित करता है?
e: Concept: Khaana pet se jab chhoti aant ke pehle hisse (duodenum) me pahunchta hai - khaas kar usme fat hone par - wahan ki cells ek hormone chhodti hain jo gallbladder tak jaata hai aur use sikudne ka signal deta hai, jisse jama hui bile duodenum me gir jati hai aur fat paachna shuru hota hai. Ye hormone Cholecystokinin (CCK) hai (chole = bile, cysto = thaili, kinin = chalana). Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Secretin pancreas se bicarbonate wala paani nikalta hai, Insulin sugar kam karta hai, aur Gastrin pet me HCl banata hai. Exam point: 'Gallbladder ko bile nikalne ka signal = CCK (duodenum ka hormone)'.

qe: The three principal digestive enzymes present in Pancreatic Juice (LAT) are:
qh: अग्नाशयी रस (Pancreatic Juice) में पाए जाने वाले तीन मुख्य एंजाइम कौन से हैं?
e: Concept: Pancreatic juice ek 'teen kaam ki' digestive juice hai jo duodenum me aata hai aur wahan ka alkaline mahaul banata hai; iske teen mukhya enzymes ko aksar 'LAT' yaad rakha jata hai: Lipase (fat ko fatty acid + glycerol me todta hai), Amylase (starch ko maltose/sugar me todta hai) aur Trypsin (protein ko peptides me todta hai). Baaki teen options doosre hisson ke enzymes hain: Maltase-Sucrase-Lactase aanton ke brush border ke, aur Pepsin-Rennin-Ptyalin pet-muh ke; Gastrin to hormone hai, enzyme nahi. Exam point: 'Pancreatic juice ke 3 main enzymes = Lipase, Amylase, Trypsin (LAT)'.

qe: Which simple monosaccharide provides instantaneous cellular energy and is the end-product of carbohydrate digestion?
qh: कौन सी सरल शर्करा तत्काल ऊर्जा देती है और कार्बोहाइड्रेट पाचन का अंतिम उत्पाद है?
e: Concept: Carbohydrate (rotan, chawal, mithai) ka paachan aakhri me 'simple sugar' par ruk jata hai, aur us simple sugar ka naam Glucose hai - yahi body ki teeno cells ka turant fuel hai; isliye blood me glucose ki maatra (blood sugar) itni strictly control ki jati hai. Glucose ki kami se sharir kamzor padta hai aur zyada hone se diabetes ka nuksaan (kidney, eye, nerve) hota hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Fructose fruit sugar, Galactose milk sugar ka hissa, aur Sucrose do sugar ka jod (disaccharide, jo aage tootna padta hai). Exam point: 'Carbohydrate ki digestion ka final product = Glucose'.

qe: What is the final absorbable molecular product of complete protein digestion in the small intestine?
qh: छोटी आंत में प्रोटीन के पूर्ण पाचन का अंतिम अवशोषित होने वाला उत्पाद क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Protein ka paachan muh/pet me chhote hisson (peptones) tak hi pahunchta hai; aage chhoti aant me pancreatic Trypsin aur aanton ke proteases use aur todte hain, aur final product banta hai Amino Acids - yahi wo chhote tukde hain jo aant ki deewar se blood me absorb hote hain aur phir sharir apne protein (muscle, enzyme, hormone) banane me use karta hai. Baaki teen intermediate ya alag cheezein hain: Peptones aur Polypeptides adhure toote protein hain (absorb nahi hote, aage tootna padta hai), aur Fatty Acids fat ke toote hisse hain. Exam point: 'Protein digestion ka final product = Amino acids'.

qe: What is the primary physiological function of the Large Intestine (Colon)?
qh: बड़ी आंत (कोलोन) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या होता है?
o: Absorption of water, electrolytes, and formation of feces
e: Concept: Badi aant (colon) khud koi enzyme chhodkar paachan nahi karti - uska kaam hai bache hue paani aur electrolytes (sodium, potassium) ko soakna aur us mal ko thick karke saaf karne layak bana dena (feces). Isi wajah se ye paani ka 'balance' banaye rakhti hai - diarrhoea me paani absorb nahi hota, aur constipation me bahut zyada soak hota hai. Baaki teen kaam badi aant nahi karti: fat paachna aur bile emulsify (wo chhoti aant) aur protein enzymes chhodna (wo pet/pancreas). Exam point: 'Colon = paani/electrolyte absorb + feces banana'.

qe: Which vestigial lymphoid structure extends from the caecum, which aided in cellulose digestion in ancient ancestors?
qh: सीकम से जुड़ा कौन सा अवशेषी अंग (Vestigial Organ) है जो पूर्वजों में सेलुलोज पचाने के काम आता था?
e: Concept: Appendix badi aant ke pehle hisse (caecum) se nikalta hua ek chhota, nali jaisa dhaan hai - ise 'vestigial' (purani vidbhavi) maana jata hai kyunki hamare herbivore purvaj isme cellulose paachne wale bacteria rakhte the, par insaan ab patton/seleka salan nahi khata isliye iska kaam nav ke barabar reh gaya hai. Par ye immune tissue (lymphoid) ka hissa hai. Baaki teen alag structures hain: Epiglottis saans ki nali ka flap, Gallbladder bile ki thaili, aur Duodenum chhoti aant ka pehla hissa. Exam point: 'Vermiform appendix = caecum ka vestigial dhaan (badh jaye to appendicitis)'.

qe: The yellow pigment of human feces is primarily imparted by the breakdown product:
qh: मानव मल का पीला रंग मुख्य रूप से किस वर्णक के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Purane laal blood cells (RBC) jab tootate hain to unke haemoglobin ke haem ka hissa tootkar Bilirubin banta hai; liver ye bilirubin bile me daal kar aanto tak bhejta hai, jahan bacteria use todkar aage ke rang me badalte hain - isi wajah se stool ka rang peela-bhura (yellow-brown) hota hai (bacteria ke bina khali bilirubin ho to rang halka milk-paun hota hai, jaisa liver bimari me). Baaki teen alag pigments hain: Melanin skin/baal ka rang, Chlorophyll paudhon ka hara, aur Urochrome peshab ka peela rang. Exam point: 'Stool ka peela rang = bilirubin + stercobilin (bilirubin breakdown se)'.

qe: In which terminal dilated pouch of the large intestine is fecal matter stored prior to defecation?
qh: मल त्याग से पहले अनपचा अपशिष्ट पदार्थ बड़ी आंत के किस भाग में संचित रहता है?
e: Concept: Badi aant ke aakhir me ek chhota seenkta hua pouch hota hai jahan mal (feces) defecation se pehle jama hota rehta hai - ise Rectum (Malashay) kehte hain; rectum ke baad anal canal aur anus aata hai, jahan se mal bahar nikalta hai. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Caecum badi aant ka shuruaati pouch (appendix wahan lagta hai), Stomach khaane ka pehla bada thaile wala hissa, aur Ileum chhoti aant ka aakhri hissa (mal wahan store nahi hota). Exam point: 'Mal ka storehouse = Rectum (Malashay)'.

qe: What is the physiological term for utilizing absorbed nutrients within somatic cells for growth and energy?
qh: अवशोषित पोषक तत्वों का कोशिकाओं द्वारा ऊर्जा और मरम्मत के लिए उपयोग करना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Sharir me paachan ka safar aise chalta hai: Ingestion (khana muh me lena), Digestion (todna), Absorption (chhote product blood me jaana), aur phir Assimilation - yaani absorb hue nutrients (glucose, amino acids, vitamins) ko cells ke andar use karke growth aur energy paida karna. Assimilation ke baad jo bacha-kucha nahi paach paya wo Egestion (mal tyagna) se bahar chala jata hai. Baaki teen shabd alag steps hain: Mastication chabana, Ingestion khana lena, aur Egestion mal nikalna. Exam point: 'Cells me nutrients ka use = Assimilation (Swangikaran)'.

qe: The mechanical breakdown of large fat globules into minute microscopic droplets by bile salts is termed:
qh: पित्त लवणों द्वारा वसा के बड़े गोलों को छोटी बूंदों में तोड़ने की भौतिक प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Fat (tel) paani me ghulti nahi, isliye aanton ke paani wale mahaul me wo badi-badi boond ban jaati hai aur us par enzymes attack nahi kar paate - pehle inhe chhota karna zaroori hai. Ye kaam bile salts karte hain: wo badi fat ki boond ko chhote-chhote microscopical boondon me tod dete hain, jise Emulsification (Payasikaran) kehte hain (jaise soap tel ko chhote boond me todta hai) - isse lipase ka area badh jata hai aur fat aasani se paachta hai. Baaki teen alag processes hain: Deamination amino acid ke nitrogen ka hatna, Esterification fat-ester banana, aur Saponification soap banana. Exam point: 'Bile salts se fat ka chhote boond me tootna = Emulsification'.

qe: The rhythmic wave-like involuntary muscular contractions propelling chyme along the alimentary canal are called:
qh: आहार नाल में भोजन को आगे खिसकाने वाली लयबद्ध मांसपेशियों की संकुचन गति क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Khana aanton me aage badhta hai bina hamari marzi ki - ye kaam Peristalsis (Kramanukunchan) naam ki rhythmic, wave jaise muscular contraction karati hai; nali ke peeche wali muscles sikudti hain aur aage wali dheeli hoti hain, jisse khaana ek taraf dhakka khata rehta hai (Muh se guda tak). Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Deglutition = nigalna, Chemiosmosis = ATP banane ka process, aur Osmosis = paani ka movement. Exam point: 'Khane ko aage badhane wali wave = Peristalsis'.

qe: Which mucosal pouch marks the junction where the terminal ileum meets the large intestine?
qh: बड़ी आंत का वह शुरुआती अंध-थैली (Blind Pouch) भाग कौन सा है जहाँ छोटी आंत आकर जुड़ती है?
e: Concept: Chhoti aant ka aakhri hissa (ileum) badi aant se milta hai, aur is milan par ek chhota thaili jaisa pouch hota hai jise Caecum kehte hain - isi se appendix nikalta hai, aur yahin se badi aant (colon) shuru hoti hai. Caecum se aage colon, phir rectum aur anal canal aate hain. Baaki teen aage-ke hisse hain: Colon (badi aant ka bada bhaag), Anal canal (aakhir ki nali) aur Rectum (mal ka store). Exam point: 'Ileum + Caecum ka junction = ileocecal valve wala junction (caecum pouch)'.

qe: In which anatomical tube of the gastrointestinal tract does NO enzymatic digestion or absorption occur?
qh: पाचन नाल के किस भाग में किसी भी प्रकार का एंजाइमी पाचन या अवशोषण नहीं होता है?
e: Concept: Esophagus (food pipe/annapath) sirf ek 'dhaan wali nali' hai jisme khana nigalne ke baad neeche pahunchta hai - ye bilkul khali dhaancha hai: yahan koi enzyme banta nahi, koi paachan nahi hota aur koi nutrient absorb nahi hota, sirf peristalsis se khana pet tak dhaata hai. Baaki teen me sab kuch hota hai: Buccal cavity (muh) me ptyalin se starch paachan, aur Ileum/Duodenum me poora paachan aur absorption. Exam point: 'GIT ka wo hissa jahan na paachan na absorption = Esophagus'.

qe: Which fluid is secreted into the duodenum that contains NO digestive enzymes yet is indispensable for lipid digestion?
qh: ग्रहणी में स्रावित होने वाला कौन सा द्रव कोई एंजाइम नहीं रखता, फिर भी वसा पाचन के लिए अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: Bile juice ke andar koi enzyme nahi hota - phir bhi ye fat paachne ke liye indispensable hai, kyunki isme bile salts hote hain jo fat ko chhote boond me todte hain (emulsification), jisse lipase theek se kaam kar pata hai; bile ke saath liver ka waste (bilirubin) bhi bahar nikalta hai. Isliye bile nahi bane to fat ke saath fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) bhi paach nahi honge. Baaki teen enzyme-wale ya protein-wale juices hain: Succus entericus (aanton ke enzymes), Gastric juice (pepsin/HCl) aur Saliva (ptyalin). Exam point: 'Bina enzyme wala zaroori juice = Bile (sirf emulsification aur waste detox)'.

qe: Which hormone released by duodenal S-cells stimulates the Pancreas to secrete watery bicarbonate-rich juice?
qh: ग्रहणी द्वारा छोड़ा जाने वाला कौन सा हार्मोन अग्नाशय को क्षारीय बाइकार्बोनेट रस छोड़ने के लिए प्रेरित करता है?
e: Concept: Duodenum ki S-cells (jo khane ka tezabi-chyme aane par aktif hoti hain) Secretin naam ka hormone chhodti hain - ye pancreas par pahunch kar use paani aur sodium bicarbonate wala juice banane ka signal deta hai, jisse duodenum ka tezab neutral ho jata hai aur pancreatic enzymes kaam kar pate hain. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Gastrin pet me HCl badhata hai, CCK gallbladder se bile aur pancreatic enzymes nikalti hai, aur Enterokinase to enzyme hai (hormone nahi) jo trypsinogen ko active karta hai. Exam point: 'Bicarbonate wala pancreatic juice = Secretin (duodenum S-cells)'.

qe: What is the semi-liquid acidic pulpy mass of partly digested food expelled by the stomach into the duodenum?
qh: आमाशय में जठर रस के साथ अच्छी तरह पिस चुके अम्लीय भोजन की लुगदी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Pet khaane ko HCl aur pepsin se milakar ek adhadhav (semi-liquid) tezabi guda banataa hai - isi mil-jul kar bane poori ko Chyme kehte hain, jo pyloric sphincter se chhota-chhota hokar duodenum me jata hai. Iske aage ye bile aur pancreatic juice se milkar alkaline ho jata hai aur paachan poora hota hai. Baaki teen alag avasthayein hain: Bolus = muh me chabaya hua khaana, Micelle = fat ka chhota boond + bile salt (jo absorb hota hai), aur Chyle = lymph me mile fat wala doodhiya dravya. Exam point: 'Pet se nikla tezabi paak = Chyme', 'muh me chabaya = Bolus'.

qe: Which proteolytic enzyme coagulates milk protein (casein) into curd in infants?
qh: शिशुओं के पेट में दूध के प्रोटीन (कैसीन) को जमाकर दही में बदलने वाला एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Chhote bachche (infant) ka pet doodh ko aise hi nikal nahi sakta - doodh ke protein (casein) ko pehle 'dahi' jaisa thakka bana kar dubay rakhna padta hai, warna wo saans ki nali me chala jayega. Isi kaam ke liye infants ke pet me ek enzyme hota hai jise Rennin (Chymosin) kehte hain; ye doodh ko coagulate karke curd bana deta hai. Ye enzyme baad me jawani me gayab ho jata hai (adult me ye kaam pepsin karta hai). Baaki teen alag enzymes hain: Pepsin protein todta hai, Lipase fat, aur Trypsin protein (pancreas ka). Exam point: 'Infant me doodh jamane wala enzyme = Rennin (Chymosin); cheese banane me bhi yehi kaam aata hai'.

qe: Which bactericidal enzyme present in saliva and tears hydrolyzes bacterial peptidoglycan cell walls?
qh: लार और आँसुओं में मौजूद कौन सा जीवाणुरोधी एंजाइम बैक्टीरिया की कोशिका भित्ति को नष्ट करता है?
e: Concept: Laar (saliva) aur aansu (tears) me ek enzyme hota hai Lysozyme - ye bacteria ki cell wall ke peptidoglycan ko tod deta hai (hydrolysis), isliye bacteria mar jaate hain. Yahi wajah hai ki muh ke ghaav aur aankhen aksar aise hi bach jate hain (aur kutte apne ghaav chatate rehte hain). Baaki teen alag padarth hain: Ptyalin starch todta hai, Mucin laar ko chipchipa banata hai, aur Pepsin pet ka protein-digesting enzyme hai. Exam point: 'Saliva aur tears ka bacteria-needing wala enzyme = Lysozyme (natural antibiotic)'.

qe: Which salivary gland is anatomically the largest and can become inflamed in mumps viral infection?
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे बड़ी लार ग्रंथि कौन सी है, जो मम्प्स (गलसुआ) वायरस से संक्रमित होकर सूज जाती है?
e: Concept: Muh me teen jodi salivary glands hoti hain - parotid (kaan ke aage, gaal me), submandibular aur sublingual. Inme sabse badi Parotid gland hoti hai, aur isi par 'mumps' virus attack karta hai - isse gaal/jaabda soojh jata hai, jise mumps kehte hain (aur khaana nigalne me takleef hoti hai). Baaki teen alag glands hain: Sublingual aur Submandibular chhoti salivary glands hain, aur Lacrimal gland aansu banati hai (mumps isse nahi hota). Exam point: 'Sabse badi salivary gland = Parotid', 'Mumps = Parotid gland ki sujan (viral)'.

qe: Why are humans physiologically unable to digest plant cellulose fibers?
qh: मनुष्य कच्ची घास या लकड़ी में मौजूद सेलुलोज को पचाने में असमर्थ क्यों होते हैं?
o: Lack of the enzyme cellulase and symbiotic rumen microflora
e: Concept: Cellulose (sabzi-fal ke reshe, chokar) bhi ek carbohydrate hai (glucose ke bade chains), par uske units ke beech ka jod (beta-linkage) todne wala enzyme Cellulase sirf bacteria, fungi aur rumen (gaay-bakri ke pet) ke microbes me hota hai - insaan ke paas wo enzyme nahi hai aur na aise symbiotic microbes hain, isliye wo cellulose paach nahi paata; wo 'roughage' ban kar bas aanton ko chalata hai. Baaki teen wajahein galat hain: daant ka na hona, pet ki acidity ya bile ka zyada nikalna cellulose ke paachan se jude nahi hain. Exam point: 'Human cellulose paach nahi sakta kyunki uske paas cellulase enzyme nahi hota'.

qe: What is the approximate total length of the continuous human alimentary canal from mouth to anus?
qh: मुख से लेकर गुदा तक फैली संपूर्ण मानव आहार नाल की अनुमानित लंबाई कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Muh se guda (anus) tak khane ki nali (alimentary canal) ek continuous pipe hai - isme muh, gala (pharynx), food pipe, pet, chhoti aant (~22 feet), badi aant (~5 feet) aur rectum-anus aate hain; sab milakar iski lambai takriban 9 meter (30-32 feet) hoti hai - sharir ke aakar se 4-5 guna lambi. Baaki teen numbers galat hain (15, 50 aur 10-12 feet). Exam point: 'Human alimentary canal ~30 feet (9 m) lambi; chhoti aant (~7 m) badi aant (~1.5 m) se lambi hoti hai'.

qe: Which cartilaginous leaf-shaped flap prevents aspirated food particles from entering the laryngeal trachea during swallowing?
qh: निगलते समय भोजन को श्वासनली (Trachea) में जाने से रोकने वाला कार्टिलेज का ढक्कन क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Nigalte waqt khana aur hawa dono ki naliyan paas paas hain - isliye ek chhota patta (leaf-shaped cartilaginous flap) hota hai jo khana nigalne par trachea (saans ki nali) ka muh dhak leta hai, taaki khana galti se phephde me na chala jaye. Is flap ko Epiglottis kehte hain; ye khiya (larynx) ke upar baitha 'guard' hai (agar yahan kuch chala jaye to chirkut/choking hoti hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Glottis khiya ka khula hissa, Pharynx gala, aur Uvula taalu ke aakhir ki latakti hui chhoti cheez. Exam point: 'Saans ki nali ka guard flap = Epiglottis'.

qe: Which specialized lymphatic capillaries located within the mucosal villi of the small intestine absorb emulsified lipids?
qh: छोटी आंत के रसांकुरों (Villi) में वसा और ग्लिसरॉल के अवशोषण के लिए कौन सी विशेष लसिका केशिकाएं होती हैं?
e: Concept: Chhoti aant ki andar ki deewar par chhote-chhote ungle (villi) hote hain, jinme ek-ek khaas lymphatic nahali hoti hai jise Lacteal kehte hain. Bade fat ke toote hisse (chylomicrons) itne bade hote hain ki seedha blood me nahi jate, isliye wo lacteals ke through lymph me jate hain aur aakhir me subclavian vein se blood me milte hain - isliye fat ka absorption blood ke bajaye lymph se hota hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Haustra colon ke pouches, Crypts of Lieberkuhn aant ki glands, aur Peyer's patches immunity wale lymphoid dhaan. Exam point: 'Fat/chylomicron ka absorption = Lacteals (chhoti aant ke villi ki lymph naliyan)'.

qe: Severe childhood protein-energy malnutrition characterized by marked muscle wasting without edema is:
qh: शिशुओं में प्रोटीन और कैलोरी दोनों की गंभीर कमी से होने वाला अत्यधिक दुर्बलता वाला रोग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Protein-energy malnutrition (PEM) me do mukhya prakar hote hain - Marasmus aur Kwashiorkor. Marasmus me bachche ko calories aur protein dono kam milte hain, isliye sharir sookhta hai, muscle patli aur kutte (bagal ki haddi) ubhar aate hain, par sujan (edema) nahi hoti. Kwashiorkor me protein kam par calorie zyada milti hai, isliye pait/taang/talwon me paani bhar jata hai (edema) aur baal patle-peele hote hain. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Pellagra (niacin ki kami), Rickets (vitamin D/calcium se haddi mulaayam). Exam point: 'Sookha marasmus (edema nahi), sooja kwashiorkor (edema hota hai) - yaad rakho: Kwashiorkor = K for khaali protein'.

qe: Which specialized gastric parietal (oxyntic) cells secrete Castle's Intrinsic Factor essential for Vitamin B12 absorption?
qh: आमाशय की कौन सी कोशिकाएं विटामिन B12 अवशोषण के लिए आवश्यक 'आंतरिक कारक' (Intrinsic Factor) और HCl स्रावित करती हैं?
e: Concept: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) khaane me hota hai par aasani se absorb nahi hota - uske liye pet ki deewar ke Parietal (Oxyntic) cells ka banaya ek protein chahiye, jise Castle's Intrinsic Factor kehte hain; ye B12 ko jakadkar ileum tak le jata hai wahan absorption ke liye. Baaki teen cells alag kaam karte hain: Goblet mucous cells mucus (mucin) chhodte hain, Enteroendocrine G-cells gastrin hormone banate hain, aur Chief peptic cells pepsinogen banate hain. Exam point: 'Vitamin B12 absorption ke liye intrinsic factor Zaroori (parietal cells); iski kami se B12 + anaemia (pernicious anaemia)'.

qe: The endocrine clusters embedded within the exocrine pancreas that synthesize and secrete insulin and glucagon are the:
qh: अग्नाशय में स्थित अंतःस्रावी कोशिकाओं के समूह जो इंसुलिन और ग्लूकागन बनाते हैं, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Pancreas do kaam karta hai - bahari hissa (exocrine) paachak enzymes (lipase, amylase, trypsin) banata hai, aur andar bikhre chhote-chhote dhaan (endocrine clusters) hormone banate hain. In dhairo ko Islets of Langerhans kehte hain, jinme beta cells Insulin aur alpha cells Glucagon banate hain - ye blood sugar control karte hain (kam hone par diabetes). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Crypts of Lieberkuhn aant ki glands, Acinar lobules pancreas ka enzyme-wala hissa, aur Brunner's glands duodenum ke mucus glands. Exam point: 'Pancreas ke hormone-wale dhaan = Islets of Langerhans (insulin + glucagon)'.

qe: Which compound tubular submucosal glands unique to the duodenum secrete alkaline bicarbonate mucus to counter gastric chyme?
qh: ग्रहणी (Duodenum) की सब-म्यूकोसा परत में पाई जाने वाली कौन सी ग्रंथियां क्षारीय बलगम छोड़ती हैं?
e: Concept: Duodenum me pet se bahut tezabi chyme aata hai, isliye wahan ke andar ko kitni hi safety chahiye - iska intezaam Brunner's glands karte hain: ye duodenum ki submucosa me baithi compound tubular glands hain jo alkaline bicarbonate wala mucus chhodti hain, jo acid ko neutral karta hai aur aant ki deewar ko bachaata hai (peptic ulcer yahin banta hai jab ye intezaam fail kare). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Peyer's patches ileum ka lymphoid tissue, Gastric pits pet ki glands, aur Kupffer cells liver ke macrophages. Exam point: 'Duodenum ke alkaline mucus glands = Brunner's glands'.

qe: Autoimmune immune destruction of small intestinal microvilli triggered by dietary wheat gluten is known as:
qh: गेहूं के 'ग्लूटेन' प्रोटीन के कारण छोटी आंत की अंदरूनी परत को नुकसान पहुँचाने वाला ऑटोइम्यून रोग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Kuch logon ko gehu (wheat) ya jau ke protein 'gluten' se allergy jaisi autoimmune pratikriya hoti hai - body ke immune cells chhoti aant ke microvilli (ungli jaisi absorb karne wali banaawat) ko hi dushman maankar todhne lagte hain. Iske kaaran villi chhote-pad jaate hain, absorption kam ho jati hai aur patient ko dast, pet dard, vajan kam ho jata hai - is bimari ko Celiac Disease kehte hain (ilaaj: gluten-free diet). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Crohn's (aant me ghaav), Diverticulitis (pouch me sujan) aur IBS (functional problem, damage nahi). Exam point: 'Gluten se immune damage = Celiac disease (gluten-free diet se thik)'.

qe: What is the physiological human dental formula for permanent adult dentition per dental quadrant?
qh: वयस्क मनुष्य का स्थायी दंत सूत्र (Dental Formula) क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke daant 'heterodont' hote hain - chaaron prakar ke (Incisors katna, Canines cheerna, Premolars aur Molars peesna), aur har jaw ke ek-or (quadrant) me ye gintee hoti hai: 2 incisors, 1 canine, 2 premolars, 3 molars = 2123. Poore muh me 4 quadrant gine to 2123/2123 = 32 daant (adult). Baaki teen formulas galat hain: 2133 aur 2102 doosre prajatiyon/avyask ke hain, aur 1023 me incisor 1 hi hai. Exam point: 'Adult dental formula = 2123/2123 = 32 daant'.

qe: What is the dental formula representing deciduous (milk) teeth in young human children?
qh: छोटे बच्चों के दूध के दाँतों का दंत सूत्र क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Chhote bachche me doodh ke daant (deciduous/milk teeth) 6 mahine se nikalna shuru hote hain aur 2-3 saal me poori set aa jati hai - inme molars sirf 2-2 hote hain (premolars nahi hote) aur kul 20 daant hote hain. Isliye doodh ke daant ka formula 2102/2102 = 20 daant (4 teesri molar bhi nahi hoti). Baaki teen formulas galat hain (2120, 2023 aur 2123 wale adult/other ke hain). Exam point: 'Milk teeth = 20 (formula 2102/2102)', 'Permanent teeth = 32 (formula 2123/2123)'.

qe: Which hepatobiliary muscular sphincter regulates the transit of bile and pancreatic secretions into the duodenal lumen?
qh: पित्त और अग्नाशयी रस को ग्रहणी में जाने से नियंत्रित करने वाला कपाट/स्फ़िंक्टर कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Liver se bani bile gallbladder me jama rehti hai, aur khana aane par usko duodenum me bhejna padta hai; is raste me ek muscular valve (sphincter) hota hai jo bile aur pancreatic juice dono ke nikalne ko control karta hai - ise Sphincter of Oddi kehte hain (ye duodenum ki deewar me hota hai, ampulla of Vater ke aas-pas). Baaki teen alag sphincters hain: Ileocaecal valve chhoti-badi aant ke beech, Cardiac sphincter food pipe-pet ke beech, aur Pyloric sphincter pet-duodenum ke beech. Exam point: 'Bile + pancreatic juice ka gate = Sphincter of Oddi'.

qe: Which brush-border intestinal enzyme activates pancreatic Trypsinogen into proteolytic Trypsin?
qh: अग्नाशय के निष्क्रिय ट्रिप्सिनोजेन को सक्रिय ट्रिप्सिन में बदलने वाला आंत्र एंजाइम कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Pancreas apne protein-todne wale enzyme (trypsin) ko 'band' (inactive) roop me banata hai - trypsinogen - warna wo khud pancreas ko paach jayega. Chhoti aant ke brush border par ek enzyme hota hai Enterokinase (Enteropeptidase), jo trypsinogen ko kaatkar active Trypsin bana deta hai; uske baad trypsin khud doosre trypsinogen ko bhi activate karta hai. Baaki teen enzymes alag hain: Lipase fat, Pepsin pet ka protein enzyme, aur Secretin to hormone hai. Exam point: 'Trypsinogen -> Trypsin = Enterokinase (chhoti aant me)'.

qe: Which anatomical segment of the small intestine is the longest and most tightly coiled?
qh: छोटी आंत का सबसे लंबा और अत्यधिक कुंडलित अंतिम भाग कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Chhoti aant ke teen hisse hote hain - pehla Duodenum (sabse chhota, C-akar, yahan bile aur pancreatic juice aate hain), beech ka Jejunum (~2.5 m, absorption ka mukhya hissa) aur aakhri Ileum (~3.5 m) jo sabse lamba aur sabse zyada lipata (coiled) hota hai; ileum me Peyer's patches (immunity) aur vitamin B12/fat ki absorption hoti hai. Baaki teen galat hain: Duodenum sabse chhota, Caecum badi aant ka hissa, aur Jejunum beech ka. Exam point: 'Chhoti aant me sabse lamba hissa = Ileum (B12 + bile salt absorption yahin)'.

qe: What is the hardest, most densely calcified and acellular tissue layer covering the crown of teeth?
qh: मानव शरीर का सबसे कठोर, सर्वाधिक खनिजीकृत और रक्त-रहित ऊतक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Daant ka bahari hissa (crown) duniya ki sabse sakht banaawat se dhaka hota hai - Tooth Enamel, jo 96% calcium phosphate (hydroxyapatite) se bana hota hai, acellular (khaali, koi cell nahi) hota hai aur isme koi nerve nahi hoti. Yahi wajah hai ki enamal ghisa ya toot gaya to dobara nahi banta (isliye brush + fluoride zaroori hai). Baaki teen andar ya peeche ki parat hain: Dentine (enamel ke andar, yellow, mei nerve hota hai), Cementum (jadi ki parat) aur Compact bone (haddi, daant me nahi). Exam point: 'Sabse sakht tissue = Enamel (body ka sabse sakht padarth bhi)'.

qe: Where are organized mucosal and submucosal lymphoid aggregates known as 'Peyer's Patches' concentrated?
qh: संक्रमण से लड़ने वाले प्रतिरक्षा लसिका ऊतक 'पेयर्स पैच' (Peyer's Patches) मुख्य रूप से कहाँ पाए जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Peyer's Patches chhoti aant ki deewar me bikhre lymphoid dhaan (jaise chhote 'checkposts') hain jo aant ke andar aaye bacteria/virus ko pakad kar immune system ko batate hain aur us area ki nigrani karte hain. Ye sabse zyada Ileum me (chhoti aant ke aakhri hisse) milte hain, isliye ileum ka immune role bahut bada hai (aur Typhoid bhi Peyer's patches par asar karta hai). Baaki teen jagah ye nahi hote: Esophagus, Stomach fundus aur Duodenum (wahan alag glands hote hain). Exam point: 'Peyer's patches = Ileum ka lymphoid tissue (typhoid me ulcer yahin bante hain)'.

qe: What term accurately characterizes human dentition based on alveolar sockets, two successive sets, and morphological variation?
qh: मसूड़ों के गड्ढों में दाँत धँसे होने, जीवन में दो बार आने और अलग-अलग प्रकार के होने को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Insaan ka daant-setbahut khaas hai, aur ise teen shabdon me describe karte hain: (1) Thecodont - daant jaw ki haddi ke socket (gadde) me baithe hote hain (jaise keel), (2) Diphyodont - zindagi me do baar uste hain (pehle milk teeth, phir permanent), aur (3) Heterodont - chaar prakar ke (incisor, canine, premolar, molar). Baaki teen combos galat hain: Monophyodont ka matlab sirf ek baar daant aana (milk teeth ka nahi), Acrodont/Pleurodont wala jaw-attachment (sarisrip me) hai, aur Homodont ka matlab sab daant ek jaise (dolphin me). Exam point: 'Human dentition = Thecodont + Diphyodont + Heterodont'.

qe: Which trace halide mineral is indispensable for strengthening hydroxyapatite enamel crystal lattice against bacterial acid dental caries?
qh: दाँतों के इनेमल को मजबूत बनाने और कैविटी/सड़न से बचाने के लिए कौन सा खनिज आवश्यक है?
e: Concept: Daant ke enamel ke andar calcium + phosphate ka hydroxyapatite ka crystal jaal (lattice) hota hai; usme thoda sa Fluorine (fluoride) ghusakar usko strong banaya ja sakta hai - fluoride se crystal jyada 'badalta' nahi, isliye bacteria ke tezaab se kam ghista hai aur cavity (dental caries) nahi banti. Isi liye toothpaste me fluoride hota hai aur pani me fluoride milaya jata hai. Baaki teen minerals alag kaam karte hain: Zinc immunity/enzymes, Iodine thyroid hormone, aur Iron haemoglobin. Exam point: 'Daant ke enamel ko strong karne wala mineral = Fluorine (cavity rokta hai)'.

qe: Which macronutrient yields the highest caloric energy density per gram through metabolic beta-oxidation?
qh: प्रति ग्राम ऑक्सीकरण पर सबसे अधिक ऊर्जा (कैलोरी) प्रदान करने वाला पोषक तत्व कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Khaane se energy 'calorie' ke hisaab se nikalte hain: 1 gram Carbohydrate = ~4 kcal, 1 gram Protein = ~4 kcal, aur 1 gram Fat/Lipid = ~9 kcal. Isiliye fat energy ka sabse jamavdaar (dense) source hai - thoda fat se bahut energy milti hai (aur yahi wajah hai ki fat bharne wale khane se vajan jaldi badhta hai), beta-oxidation se fat ke fatty acids tootkar ATP dete hain. Baaki teen ka energy galat hai: Protein 4 kcal/g, Carbohydrate 4 kcal/g, Vitamins 0 kcal/g (energy nahi dete). Exam point: 'Fat = 9 kcal/g (sabse zyada energy density), Protein aur Carbs = 4 kcal/g'.

qe: Which neuroendocrine mucosal cells of the stomach antrum synthesize and secrete the peptide hormone Gastrin?
qh: आमाशय के पाइलोरिक भाग की कौन सी कोशिकाएं 'गैस्ट्रिन' (Gastrin) हार्मोन स्रावित करती हैं?
e: Concept: Pet ki andar ki parat (mucosa) me khaas neuroendocrine cells hote hain jo khaana aane par (aur khusus kar protein se) hormone chhodte hain - in cells ko Enteroendocrine G-cells kehte hain, aur hormone ko Gastrin. Gastrin blood se jaakar parietal cells ko HCl banane, chief cells ko pepsinogen aur motility badhane ka signal deta hai (isliye ye 'digestion ka switch' hai; Zollinger-Ellison syndrome me gastrin bahut zyada banta hai jisse ulcer hote hain). Baaki teen cells alag kaam karte hain: Parietal cells HCl + intrinsic factor, Kupffer cells liver ke, aur Chief cells pepsinogen. Exam point: 'Gastrin = G-cells (stomach antrum) se; HCl banane ka signal'.

qe: Which anatomical segment of the small intestine serves as the principal site for the active mucosal absorption of dietary iron?
qh: भोजन से प्राप्त आयरन (लोहे) का अवशोषण मुख्य रूप से छोटी आंत के किस भाग में होता है?
e: Concept: Iron (loha) body ke liye zaroori hai (haemoglobin ka hissa), aur uski absorption mukhya rup se chhoti aant ke sabse pehle hisse - Duodenum - me hoti hai, khaas kar tezabi mahaul me aur Vitamin C ki upasthiti me (isliye iron ki goli nimbu-paani ke saath leni chahiye). Iron ka absorption body ki zaroorat ke hisaab se control hota hai; bacha hua iron stool se bahar nikal jata hai (isliye zyada iron goliyaan nuksaan karti hain). Baaki teen hisse iron nahi khinchtes: Colon, Caecum aur Terminal ileum (ileum vitamin B12 khinchta hai). Exam point: 'Iron absorption = Duodenum (Vitamin C se absorption badhti hai)'.

qe: The specialized mesenchyme-derived cells residing within dental pulp that continuously generate and repair dentine are:
qh: दाँत के पल्प में स्थित कौन सी कोशिकाएं डेंटिन (Dentine) परत का निर्माण और मरम्मत करती हैं?
e: Concept: Daant ke andar ek 'pulp cavity' hoti hai jisme blood naliyan aur nerve rehti hain, aur uski deewar par ek khaas cell parat hoti hai - Odontoblasts - jo zindagi bhar nayi dentine (daant ki andar ki haddi jaisa padarth) banate rehte hain. Isliye jab daant me halki cavity ban jaye to odontoblasts bhi thoda naya dentine daal kar use dhak lete hain (repair), aur isi wajah se daant(s) andar se gehra rang le lete hain. Baaki teen doosre kaam karte hain: Osteoclasts haddi todte hain, Ameloblasts enamel banate hain (aur nikal jaate hain), aur Chondrocytes cartilage banate hain. Exam point: 'Dentine banane/repair karne wale = Odontoblasts (pulp me)'.

qe: What is the diagnostic significance of the gastric 'Rugae' mucosal folds?
qh: आमाशय (पेट) की अंदरूनी परत में पाए जाने वाले 'रूगी' (Rugae) सिलवटों का क्या कार्य है?
o: Allowing gastric expansion and distension to accommodate large meals
e: Concept: Khali pet kabhi chhota, to khaane ke baad bada ho jata hai - is flexibility ka raaz pet ki andar ki parat ki badi-badi fold (Rugae) hain. Ye folds khule ho jati hain, jisse pet ka andar ka area/volume badh jata hai aur bade bhojan ko samet leta hai (ek baar me 1-1.5 litre se 4 litre tak). Baaki teen kaam Rugae nahi karte: polypeptide ka direct absorption, fat emulsification aur duodenal juice neutralization. Exam point: 'Rugae = pet ki folds jo expansion karne deti hain (khaana sametne ke liye)'.

qe: Failure of the lower esophageal gastroesophageal sphincter to prevent acid regurgitation into the esophagus causes:
qh: निचले इसोफेगल स्फिंक्टर के ठीक से बंद न होने के कारण पेट के एसिड का ऊपर ग्रास नली में आना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Khaane ki nali ke aakhir me pet aata hai, aur pet me HCl tezab banta hai - usko pet me upar jaane se koi sphincter rokta hai, jise lower esophageal (cardiac) sphincter kehte hain. Agar ye sphincter dheela ho jaye ya galat khule to pet ka tezab upar food pipe me chala jata hai, jisse seene me jalan aur khatta dhakka (acid regurgitation) hota hai - ise Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD/Heartburn) kehte hain. Baaki teen alag conditions hain: Dumping syndrome (khana tezi se aanton me), Achalasia (sphincter khulta hi nahi), Gastric volvulus (pet mud jata hai). Exam point: 'Pet ka tezab food pipe me aana = GERD/Hearthburn'.

qe: The specialized resident hepatic macrophages aligned within hepatic sinusoids responsible for phagocytosing pathogens are:
qh: यकृत (Liver) में पाए जाने वाले विशिष्ट मैक्रोफेज जो बैक्टीरिया और मृत RBCs को नष्ट करते हैं, क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Liver ke andar 'sinusoids' naam ki khaas chaudi nahaliyan hote hain jisme blood dheere-dheere behta hai; inki deewar me baithe khaas macrophages 'Kupffer cells' kahlate hain. Ye aant se seedha aaye khoon me se bacteria, toxin aur mar chuke cell ko kha jate hain (phagocytosis), isliye liver ka 'first filter' yahi hai. Baaki teen cells alag kaam karte hain: Brunner's cells duodenum ke mucous glands, Hepatocytes liver ki asli kaam wali cells (detox/protein), aur Paneth cells chhoti aant ke antibacterial cells. Exam point: 'Liver me baithe macrophages = Kupffer cells (blood filter)'.

qe: Which mucosal neurohormone produced primarily by stomach neuroendocrine cells triggers hypothalamic orexigenic hunger sensations?
qh: भूख लगने पर आमाशय द्वारा स्रावित होने वाला कौन सा हार्मोन मस्तिष्क को भूख का संकेत (Hunger Hormone) देता है?
e: Concept: Bhoojh (khane ki bhookh) sirf aanto ke bharne se nahi, hormono se bhi lagti hai. Pet khaali hone par uski deewar se ek hormone nikalta hai - Ghrelin - jo blood se brain ke hypothalamus tak jaata hai aur bhookh ka ehsas dilata hai (isliye ise 'hunger hormone' kehte hain); khana aane par ye kam ho jata hai. Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Insulin sugar ghataata hai, CCK gallbladder se bile nikalta hai, aur Leptin fat cells se nikalta hai jo bhookh kam karta hai. Exam point: 'Bhookh badhane wala hormone = Ghrelin (pet se)', 'bhookh ghataane wala = Leptin (fat cells se)'.

qe: Which adipose tissue hormone signals long-term energy sufficiency to the hypothalamus to suppress appetite (Satiety Hormone)?
qh: पेट भरा होने का अहसास कराने वाला और भूख को दबाने वाला (Satiety Hormone) कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Sharir me 'kitna khana chahiye' ka faisla do hormones karte hain - pet se Ghrelin (bhookh badhao) aur fat cells se Leptin (bhookh ghatao). Leptin fat cells se nikalta hai aur brain ko batata hai ki 'kitni energy jama hai', isliye ise 'Satiety (pet bharne ka) hormone' kehte hain; jab tak badan me charbi zyada hai ye bhookh rokta hai, par motape me brain leptin ko 'sunna' band kar deta hai (resistance). Baaki teen alag hormones hain: Ghrelin bhookh badhata hai, Secretin pancreatic juice, aur Gastrin HCl. Exam point: 'Satiety/bhookh ghataane wala = Leptin (fat cells)'.

qe: What clinical term describes the neurological motility failure of the lower esophageal sphincter to relax during swallowing?
qh: निगलते समय ग्रास नली के निचले स्फिंक्टर का न खुल पाना जिससे भोजन पेट में नहीं जा पाता, क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Khaana nigalte waqt food pipe ke aakhir wale sphincter ko khulna chahiye, par kuch logon me ye sphincter khulta hi nahi (relax fail) aur uske saath nerve bhi kharab ho jati hai - isse khaana food pipe me atak jata hai, nigalna mushkil hota hai aur ulti (regurgitation) hoti hai; ye bimari Achalasia Cardia kehlati hai. Iska ilaaj balloon dilatation ya surgery se hota hai. Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Cirrhosis liver ka, Dyspepsia paachan ki takleef, aur Hiatal hernia jisme pet ka hissa chest me aa jata hai. Exam point: 'Nigalne me food pipe ka sphincter na khulna = Achalasia cardia'.

qe: Which three longitudinal ribbons of smooth muscle on the outer colon create the characteristic sacculated pouches (Haustra)?
qh: बड़ी आंत पर पाई जाने वाली तीन अनुदैर्ध्य चिकनी पेशी पट्टियाँ कौन सी हैं जो उसमें पाउच (Haustra) बनाती हैं?
e: Concept: Badi aant (colon) ki deewar par teen pattiyan (ribbons) hui lambai ki taraf chalti hain - inhe Taeniae Coli kehte hain. Ye pattiyan chhoti hoti hain (colon se), isliye colon unke beech me sikudkar gathilon jaisi pooch (pouches) banata hai, jinhe Haustra kehte hain - yahi unka 'bundle' dikhne ka kaaran hai. Baaki teen alag cheezein hain: Mesentery peritoneum ki fold hai, Muscularis mucosae andar ki patli muscle parat, aur Sphincters of Oddi bile ka valve. Exam point: 'Colon ke 3 ribbons = Taeniae coli; inke beech ke pooch = Haustra'.

qe: The presence of bulky, foul-smelling, pale stools containing unabsorbed excess dietary fat is medically diagnosed as:
qh: मल में वसा (फैट) का ठीक से पाचन न होने के कारण अत्यधिक तेल/चिकनाई का बाहर निकलना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Agar fat theek se paach nahi pata (jaise lipase ki kami, pancreas ki bimari, bile duct block ya celiac disease me) to fat stool me hi chala jata hai - aise stool ko Steatorrhea kehte hain: ye bada (bulky), pale (badbudaar) aur 'chipakne wala' hota hai, paani me tairta hai. Baaki teen stool-related conditions alag hain: Melena kaala-tar (blood, upar ki bleeding se), Hematochezia laal khoon wala stool (neeche ki bleeding se), aur Dysentery nal (blood + mucus wale dast). Exam point: 'Pale, badbudar, fat wala stool = Steatorrhea'.

qe: Which enteric autonomous nervous plexus situated between circular and longitudinal muscularis layers regulates gastrointestinal motility?
qh: आहार नाल की पेशी परतों के बीच स्थित कौन सा तंत्रिका जाल (Plexus) पाचन तंत्र की गति और पेरिस्टालसिस को नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Concept: Aanton ki deewar me do mukhya nerve plexuses (jaal) hote hain, jo 'chhota dimag' ki tarah motility aur secretion control karte hain. Inme sabse bada Auerbach's (Myenteric) plexus hai, jo circular aur longitudinal muscle paraton ke beech baitha hai aur peristalsis (khane ko aage dhaakne wali wave) ko chalata hai. Doosra Meissner's submucosal plexus andar ki parat me baith kar secretion aur blood flow control karta hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Celiac ganglion ek sympathetic ganglion, Vagal trunk brain se aane wali nerve, aur Meissner's isse alag (chhota) plexus. Exam point: 'Motility/peristalsis ka plexus = Auerbach's (Myenteric)'.

qe: What physiological reflex induces massive colonic mass propulsive contractions immediately following gastric distension by food?
qh: खाना खाते ही आमाशय के भरने पर बड़ी आंत में मल त्याग की तीव्र इच्छा जगाने वाला रिफ्लेक्स कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Khaana pet me pahunchte hi ek reflex kaam karta hai jise Gastro-colic reflex kehte hain - ye khane se bade (mass) colonic movement paida karta hai aur subah ya khaane ke baad 'reply' (motion) ki tayari ho jati hai. Isi wajah se subah khali pet chai-nashte ke baad stool ki thongs lagti hai. Baaki teen alag reflexes hain: Defecation inhibition (rokna), Baroreceptor reflex (BP control), aur Enterogastric reflex (pet khaali hone par khane ki speed ghataata hai). Exam point: 'Khane ke baad colon ka tez movement = Gastro-colic reflex (budhwar subah reply ka raaz)'.

qe: Which vitamin deficiency classically manifests as atrophic tongue inflammation and burning (Glossitis)?
qh: जीभ की सूजन, लालिमा और जलन (ग्लोसाइटिस) मुख्य रूप से किस विटामिन की कमी का संकेत है?
e: Concept: Zubaan ki sujan aur jalan (glossitis) ka classic kaaran Vitamin B-complex ki kami hai - khaas kar Riboflavin (B2), aur saath me Niacin (B3) aur B12 ki kami se bhi jeebh laal-chikni aur jalne wali hoti hai. Vitamin B2 zaroori hai energy metabolism aur mucous membrane (shleshmak pati) ki healthy rakhne ke liye; iski kami se hoth faatna, jeebh me dard (angular stomatitis) bhi hote hain. Baaki teen vitamins aise nahi karte: Vitamin A raat ke andhepan, K bleeding, D haddi ki kamzori se juda hai. Exam point: 'Glossitis/burning tongue = Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) aur B-complex ki kami'.

qe: What is the common clinical term applied to the human third permanent molars that erupt between late adolescence and adulthood?
qh: 17 से 25 वर्ष की आयु में सबसे अंत में निकलने वाले तीसरे मोलर दाँत को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke mukhya daant 2 saal ki umer tak 20 aa jate hain; 6-7 saal me wo girne lagte hain aur permanent daant nikalna shuru hote hain - inme sabse aakhir (late teens/20-25 saal) 4 daant (aakhir wale) nikalte hain, jinhe 'Wisdom Teeth' ya Akal Daadh kehte hain (dant formula me teesri molar = 3rd molar). Kyunki ye umer me nikalte hain jab insaan ko samajh (akal) aa jati hai, isliye ye naam pada. Baaki teen daant pehle nikal wale hain ya doodh wale: Incisors, Milk molars aur Canines. Exam point: 'Sabse aakhir me nikalne wale daant = Wisdom teeth (3rd molar, 17-25 saal)'.

qe: Which mutualistic colonic gut bacterium produces significant metabolic pools of Vitamin K and biotin absorbed by the human host?
qh: मनुष्य की बड़ी आंत में कौन सा सहजीवी बैक्टीरिया रहता है जो विटामिन K और बायोटिन का संश्लेषण करता है?
e: Concept: Hamari aant me lagbhag 1000 kism ke crore bacteria rehte hain, jinhe 'gut flora' kehte hain - ye khane ke bache hisson ko khaate hain aur badle me hamare liye faaydemand cheezein banate hain. Inme sabse mashhoor Escherichia coli (E. coli) hai, jo badi aant me rehta hai aur Vitamin K, biotin aur kuch B-vitamins banata hai, jinhe hamara sharir absorb kar leta hai; ye vitamin B12 bhi banane me madad karta hai. Baaki teen bimariyan paida karne wale pathogens hain: Vibrio cholerae (haiza), Streptococcus pneumoniae (nimonia), aur Salmonella typhi (typhoid). Exam point: 'Aant ka vitamin K/biotin banane wala friend = E. coli (aur gut bacteria)'.

qe: What pathological mechanism precipitates the devastating tissue autodigestion observed in Acute Pancreatitis?
qh: तीव्र अग्नाशयशोथ (Acute Pancreatitis) में अग्नाशय खुद अपने ही ऊतकों को क्यों पचाने लगता है?
o: Retrograde inflow of acidic gastric HCl
Premature intra-pancreatic activation of Trypsinogen into Trypsin
Direct bacterial infection of insulin granules
e: Concept: Pancreas apne digestive enzymes ko 'band' (inactive) roop me banata hai - jaise trypsinogen - taaki wo khud pancreas ko na paach lein. Agar kisi wajah se (alcohol, pathri, infection, gallbladder ka problem) ye trypsinogen samay se pehle pancreas ke andar hi activate hokar Trypsin ban jaye, to wo andar ke proteins ko todne lagta hai - isse pancreas khud apni 'self-digestion' (autodigestion) karne lagta hai, tez dard hota hai aur ye Acute Pancreatitis kehlata hai. Baaki teen wajahein galat hain: HCl ka ulta aana, insulin granules ka infection, aur artery ka band hona pancreatitis ka mechanism nahi. Exam point: 'Acute pancreatitis = trypsinogen ka samay se pehle pancreas ke andar active ho jaana (autodigestion)'.
